title: Dual Representation Enhanced Diffusion Policy for Flexible Job Shop Scheduling
abstract: arXiv:2611.15246v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The Flexible Job-Shop Scheduling Problem (FJSP) is a fundamental and challenging optimization problem in smart manufacturing. Although recent deep reinforcement learning (DRL) approaches can learn effective scheduling policies through interaction with the environment, their performance often degrades as problem scale and processing-time uncertainty increase. In this paper, we propose DredRL, a dual representation enhanced diffusion-policy reinforcement learning scheduler. DredRL first constructs enhanced dual representations of operations and machines through self- and cross-attention mechanisms to capture both intra-entity and inter-entity dependencies. A diffusion model is further employed as the policy network, generating scheduling decisions through iterative denoising conditioned on the encoded state to enhance policy expressiveness and robustness. translated_title: 面向柔性作业车间调度的双重表示增强扩散策略
translated_abstract: 柔性作业车间调度问题是智能制造中一个基础且具有挑战性的优化问题。尽管近期的深度强化学习方法可以通过与环境的交互学习有效的调度策略，但其性能往往随着问题规模和处理时间不确定性的增加而下降。本文提出了DredRL，一种双重表示增强的扩散策略强化学习调度器。DredRL首先通过自注意力和交叉注意力机制构建工序与机器的增强双重表示，以捕捉实体内部和实体之间的依赖关系。进一步采用扩散模型作为策略网络，基于编码状态通过迭代去噪生成调度决策，从而增强策略的表达能力和鲁棒性。在合成、公开、大规模以及随机FJSP基准上进行了大量实验验证。
tldr: 本文提出DredRL方法，通过自注意力与交叉注意力机制构建工序和机器的双重增强表示，并利用扩散模型作为策略网络进行迭代去噪以生成调度决策，从而显著提升了深度强化学习在大规模和不确定环境下求解柔性作业车间调度问题的性能与鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: DredRL enhances diffusion-policy reinforcement learning for flexible job-shop scheduling by constructing dual representations of operations and machines through self- and cross-attention mechanisms and using a diffusion model to generate robust scheduling decisions via iterative denoising, improving performance on large-scale and stochastic FJSP instances.
